What we store, where and how to delete it

Your workouts, meals, measurements and settings are stored on this phone. If you have an account, there\'s also a private copy on the FITNEX server so you can recover them on another device. Only you can read it.

Something is only sent when you talk to the assistant, ask for a routine or analyze a photo, and only if you\'ve given permission. That data goes through the FITNEX server and Google Gemini to generate the answer. You can remove the permission at any time.
FITNEX doesn\'t show calories, weight goals or diet calculators to minors. It focuses on variety, water and safe exercise.
When you scan a product, only the barcode is sent to Open Food Facts. Health Connect data is only read if you allow it in Android.
